text:
Ellen: Quick ask from Customer Y: staged rollout for EU+APAC, but they want an "AB stoplight" so we can pause the economics phase by metric. Need a tiny ops-ready spec.
Carlos: OK. I propose a 3-stage flow: shadow -> micro-canary -> AB-econ. The AB-econ should have an explicit stoplight: GREEN=go, YELLOW=restrict (scale back pct), RED=rollback.
Pri: SRE constraints: stoplight decisions must be automated but require manual ack to progress from YELLOW->GREEN. RED triggers immediate route fallback. Also require 3 consecutive 5m windows to turn RED to avoid flapping.
Yuna: Data: AB-econ will compare quality (embedding drift) and cost-per-token. We'll sample 1k responses/hour and run paired A/B tests. Stoplight rules: if cost delta > 12% OR embed_drift > 0.03 -> set YELLOW; if either persists for 30m -> RED.
Carlos: Draft flag + routing model: flag key = rollout.ab.stoplight. Payload: {mode: shadow|canary|ab, stoplight_state: GREEN|YELLOW|RED, allowed_pct}. We'll implement policy engine to map state->allowed_pct and fallback target.
Ellen: Customer needs per-tenant opt-in for first week and an approval webhook for enterprise accounts. Add per-tenant override with audit trail.
Pri: Rollback ladder: 1) route to stable-v1, 2) set rollout.ab.stoplight=RED for region, 3) freeze all rollouts. All 3 steps logged and correlated; ops-bot should perform 1 automatically when RED triggers.
ops-bot: Canary initiated: rollout=ab-stoplight-2026 slice=eu-small pct=1 start=6248888888
Yuna: Telemetry windows: 5m rolling for latency/errors, 15m rolling for AB stoplight economics, 1h for spend. Require 3 consecutive 5m windows to trigger latency/error trips. For the econ stoplight require 2 consecutive 15m windows.
Carlos: Implementation note: policy objects are stored immutable (write-once). Any config change creates a new policy id. That helps audits.
Pri: Add hysteresis: after auto-RED, lock re-enable for 20m and require manual SRE approval to move to YELLOW. Also require a canary dry-run after any change.
Ellen: Launch criteria draft:
- Shadow run 3d with no regressions on eval set
- Micro-canaries (eu small+medium) run 24h with stoplight staying GREEN
- AB econ: p < 0.05 on quality or cost within thresholds for 48h
- Ops runbook + per-tenant opt-ins processed
Carlos: For per-tenant token shielding: if tenant_tokens_hour > budget*0.9 -> cap that tenant to quantized model for 10m, then to cached responses if persists. Provide tenant-level logs.
Yuna: We'll produce a short AB report with per-region slices, p-values, and recommended stoplight state. Also include per-tenant exceptions if a big customer skews metrics.
Pri: Contract tests: ensure function-calling payloads, streaming fallback, and tool-calls survive routing to stable-v1. Add quick smoke: `POST /internal/test/roundtrip` with representative payloads.
Carlos: Timeline: feature flag + policy engine (2 sprints), data harness + AB pipeline (1 sprint), internal shadow 1 week, then micro-canary.
Ellen: Communication plan: 72h banner + 48h email. We'll also include a short FAQ about stoplight states so customers know what YELLOW means.
ops-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: p95=162ms (+10%), error_rate=0.08%, embed_drift=0.009, cost_delta=+6% monitoring
Ellen: This looks good. Please drop blockers in the doc by EOD Friday. We'll do a dry-run Monday and lock the stoplight thresholds. Thanks all :sparkles:
